The first disconnection forms the sulfonamide bond (template 733) between p‑toluidine and a sulfonyl‑chloride intermediate. The sulfonyl‑chloride is generated in the second step by amide formation (template 401931) from 4‑aminobenzenesulfonyl chloride and trans‑cinnamoyl chloride. All three starting materials are inexpensive and readily purchasable, keeping the total cost well below $9999.</thought>
